g_notes: SKIP — broad HR/HRIS digital-transformation subject (payroll, self-service, chatbots, onboarding software); recruitment is only one bullet among many, and HRIS/payroll digitization is explicitly off-limits. Different product world from skills assessment.

SKIP — HR Operations as a function covers payroll, HRIS maintenance, compliance, onboarding/offboarding administration; recruitment is one responsibility among six. Payroll/HRIS record-keeping is explicitly off-limits.
SKIP — workforce optimization is call-center/retail scheduling, time-tracking, and WFO software; a workforce-management category, not skills assessment or hiring. Different product world.

SKIP — LGBTQ inclusive-language guidance spans pronouns, benefits terminology, and everyday workplace speech; only one bullet (job postings) touches hiring. Core subject is DEI/workplace-culture, a different product world than skills assessment, so it stays out even though the buyer overlaps.

SKIP — job enlargement/enrichment is post-hire job-design theory (expanding an existing employee's duties), not hiring or skills assessment. Doesn't fit internal mobility (that's about moving people via proven skills, not redesigning a current role) — different product world.
